items.title: 2.3.2 Ionization energy aur energy levels (electronic shells) ka taalluq (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.3.2, printed pages 27-29.

blocks.text: Mukhtalif shells ke electrons mein bara farq un ki energy ka hai, is liye atoms ki electronic configuration un ke electrons ki energies naap kar jaanchi ja sakti hai, jo ionization energies naap kar hota hai. Yeh do tarah istemal hoti hain: ek hi unsur ki yake-baad-deegre (successive) ionization energies, aur mukhtalif anasir ki pehli ionization energies.
Ek hi unsur ki successive ionization energies

Atom ka har electron ek ek kar ke nikalne ke liye darkar energy napi ja sakti hai: X se X+ + e- (delta H i1), X+ se X2+ + e- (delta H i2), X2+ se X3+ + e- (delta H i3), aur yun aage, jab tak sirf nucleus reh jaye. Yeh silsila successive ionization energies hai, aur yeh shells mein electrons ki tarteeb saaf dikhata hai. Magnesium ke liye successive ionization energies ko nikale gaye electrons ki tadaad ke muqable plot karein to qeematein valence shell se androoni shells ki taraf jate hue barhti hain. Pehle do electrons sab se bahar wale shell se aate hain aur kam energy chahte hain, magar teesra nikalte waqt bara izafa hota hai, kyunke do bahar wale electrons jane ke baad agla nucleus ke bohat qareeb wale shell se aana hota hai. Agle saat electrons doosre shell se batadreej (gradual) izafe ke saath nikalte hain, aur aisi hi magar kahin bari chhalang gyarhwein aur barhwein electron ke nikalne par hoti hai, jo nucleus ke saath wale pehle, sab se androoni shell se aate hain. Yeh do bari chhalangein is baat ka bohat achha saboot hain ke magnesium ke electrons teen mukhtalif shells mein hain.

blocks.alt: Magnesium ke liye nikale gaye electrons ki tadaad (1 se 12) ke muqable log10 ionization energy ka graph, Mg ke shells (2, 8 aur 2 electrons) ke khaake ke saath. Electrons 1 aur 2 (teesra shell) neeche hain; electron 3 se pehle bari chhalang (2nd Jump); electrons 3 se 10 (doosra shell) ahista barhte hain; electrons 11 aur 12 (pehla shell) se pehle aur bari chhalang (1st Jump).
blocks.caption: Figure 2.4: Mg ki successive ionization energies ka plot (kitab ki Figure 2.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Graph mein har nishan ek electron nikalne ki energy hai (log10 paimane par). Pehle do electrons (hare) bahar ke teesre shell se aasani se nikalte hain. Teesra electron doosre shell se aata hai jo nucleus ke bohat qareeb hai, is liye wahan bari chhalang hai (kitab isay 2nd Jump kehti hai). Phir aath electrons (surkh) ahista barhti energy se nikalte hain, aur aakhri do (neele) pehle shell se, ek aur bari chhalang (1st Jump) ke baad. Do chhalangein teen shells (2, 8, 2) ka saboot hain. Kitab ki figure mein nuqte ek khaana daen khiske hue chhape hain (pehla nuqta 2 par); yahan har nuqta apne sahi number 1 se 12 par hai.
Mukhtalif atoms ki pehli ionization energies

Doosra tareeqa yeh dekhna hai ke anasir ki pehli ionization energies atomic number ke saath kaise badalti hain; pehle 88 anasir ka plot yeh dikhata hai. Sab ionization energies shiddat se endothermic hain: electron ko atom se alag karne mein energy lagti hai. Group mein neeche, misal ke taur par helium se neon se argon ya lithium se sodium se potassium, ionization energies ghatti hain: atom jitna bara, electron alag karna utna asaan, kyunke group mein neeche shells ki tadaad barhti hai aur valence electrons par nucleus ki pakar kam hoti hai. Period mein aage ionization energies aam taur par barhti hain: group 1 ke alkali metals har period mein sab se kam aur noble gases sab se zyada rakhte hain, kyunke shell number wahi rehta hai jabke proton number barhta hai, electrons usi shell mein shamil hote hain aur nucleus valence electrons ko zyada zor se khinchta hai.

blocks.alt: Pehle 88 anasir ki pehli ionization energy (0 se 2500 kJ fi mol) aur atomic number ka graph, Z = 10, 18, 36, 54 aur 86 par lakeeron aur periods ke naamon ke saath. Noble gases He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe aur Rn chotiyan hain aur alkali metals Li, Na, K, Rb aur Cs gehraiyan; har period mein energy barhti hai aur group mein neeche chotiyan neechi hoti jati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.5: Pehle 88 anasir ki ionization energies aur atomic number ka plot (kitab ki Figure 2.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har period mein graph alkali metal (Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs) ki gehrai se shuru ho kar noble gas (He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, Rn) ki choti tak charhta hai. Group mein neeche chotiyan aur gehraiyan dono neeche aati hain, kyunke atom bara hota jata hai. At aur Fr ke hisse dashed hain, jaise kitab mein. Kitab mein Period 5 ka naam chhapne se reh gaya hai; yahan Z = 36 se 54 ke beech 'Period 5' likha gaya hai.

blocks.caption: Successive ionization energies parhna
rows: Bohat zyada pehli qeemat: noble gas
Kam pehli qeemat, bari chhalang: ek bahar wala electron, reactive metal
Do bahar wale electrons munasib qeemat par: AX2 banane wala metal
Zyada pehli qeemat, koi bari chhalang nahi: reactive non-metal

blocks.prompt: Aluminium ki successive ionization energies 580, 1815, 2740 aur 11,600 kJ fi mol hain. Rujhan aur teesri aur chauthi qeemat ke darmiyan bare izafe ki wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Har electron barhte musbat ion se nikalta hai jo apne baqi electrons ko zyada mazbooti se pakarta hai, to qeematein barhti hain. Pehle teen bahar wale teesre shell se aate hain. Chautha doosre shell se aana hai, nucleus ke bohat qareeb aur kam shield-shuda, to us ka nikalna kahin mehnga hai, isi liye 2740 se 11,600 ki chhalang shells ki sarhad batati hai.

items: Ek unsur ki successive ionization energies barhti hain, aur jahan naya androoni shell aaye wahan bari chhalangein: magnesium ki do chhalangein 2, 8 aur 2 ke shells dikhati hain.

Anasir ki pehli ionization energies sab endothermic hain, group mein neeche girti hain (zyada shells, kamzor pakar) aur period mein barhti hain (wahi shell, zyada protons): alkali metals sab se kam, noble gases sab se zyada.
